shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- FILES ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/i18n && printf '\\n--- installed versions ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json').version\" && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\" && printf '\\n--- i18n docs/readme ---\\n' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n && (sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md || true)"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- uikit configure ---' && rg -n \"function configure|declare function configure|type Lang|lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40 && printf '%s\\n' '--- i18n exports/types ---' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json').exports\" && rg -n \"setLang|registerKeysets|type Lang|I18N\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts && sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && sed -n '60,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Option.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/tech-components.d.ts && rg -n \"onUpdate\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useSelect/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/tech-components.d.ts; printf '\\n--- useSelect types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useSelect/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- uikit readme i18n config ---\\n'; rg -n \"configure\\(|lang:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '70,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"
/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/i18n && npm view @gravity-ui/i18n version peerDependencies --json && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)\""
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/i18n.ts && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && ls src'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export declare enum Lang|const Lang|Lang\\[\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/export type AppLanguage = Lang;/export type AppLanguage = (typeof Lang)[keyof typeof Lang];/; s/import { configure, type Lang } from '@gravity-ui\\/uikit';/import { configure, Lang } from '@gravity-ui\\/uikit';/\" src/i18n.ts
sed -i \"s/language === 'en' ? en : ru/language === Lang.En ? en : ru/\" src/i18n.ts
sed -i \"s/i18n.setLang('en');/i18n.setLang(Lang.En);/; s/configure({ lang: 'en' });/configure({ lang: Lang.En });/\" src/i18n.ts
sed -i \"s/useState<AppLanguage>('en')/useState<AppLanguage>(Lang.En)/\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,40p' src/i18n.ts && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && sed -n '1,30p' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export .*Lang|declare const Lang|Lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30 && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/types.d.ts && rg -n \"useLang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/import { appLanguages, i18n, languageNames, setAppLanguage, type AppLanguage } from '.\\/i18n';/import { appLanguages, i18n, languageNames, setAppLanguage, type AppLanguage } from '.\\/i18n';\\nimport { Lang } from '@gravity-ui\\/uikit';/\" src/App.tsx
# restore explicit union type for language names
sed -i \"s/export type AppLanguage = (typeof Lang)\\[keyof typeof Lang\\];/export type AppLanguage = Lang.En | Lang.Ru;/\" src/i18n.ts
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/i18n.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/types.d.ts && rg -n \"Lang =|const Lang|type Lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/i18n.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/export const appLanguages: AppLanguage\\[\\] = \\['en', 'ru'\\];/export const appLanguages: AppLanguage[] = [Lang.En, Lang.Ru];/\" src/i18n.ts && sed -i \"s/en: 'English',/en: 'English',/; s/ru: 'Русский',/ru: 'Русский',/\" src/i18n.ts && sed -i \"s/export const languageNames: Record<AppLanguage, string> = {/export const languageNames: Record<AppLanguage, string> = {/\" src/i18n.ts && sed -n '1,12p' src/i18n.ts && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/i18n.ts package.json && ls src'
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba src/main.tsx && nl -ba src/App.tsx && nl -ba src/i18n.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/i18n.ts && echo '---' && cat src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/i18n.ts && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && ls -l src && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- i18n ---\\n' && cat src/i18n.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/i18n.ts && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s' '' > src/App.tsx
printf '%s' '' > src/main.tsx
printf '%s' '' > src/i18n.ts
cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; cat src/i18n.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba src/App.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'truncate -s 0 src/App.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'truncate -s 0 src/App.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'truncate -s 0 src/App.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'truncate -s 0 src/App.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | tail -20 && printf '\\n--- i18n ---\\n' && nl -ba src/i18n.ts | tail -20 && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && nl -ba src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- final files ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- i18n ---\\n' && cat src/i18n.ts && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- build ---\\n' && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat'
